page.layout: One printed page, single block of text in the upper middle of the scan, with no columns and no margin notes. Faint lines of large capitals sit near the top third, with smaller lines beneath them.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and heavily stained. The upper-middle block looks like a title page with large capitals, but its letters cannot be read, so the lines above are placeholders and their number is approximate. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side may be mixed in with it. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. Stains and the book's edge at the right are not transcribed.
